messages:
lina: Heads up — KMS audit + recent RBAC schema refactor surfaced a weird class of residual grants. looks like some legacy default roles still grant read access to secrets after the v3 role backfill.
devon: ouch. which backfill/migration ran? perm_v3_backfill?
samir: yes perm_v3_backfill ran last night across shard9-12. we saw a small error rate but assumed safe.
lina: exact symptom: audit logs show service-account tokens (svc-data-*) using kms:Decrypt on customer keys even though new role matrix shouldn't allow that. repeated across 3 customers.
maria: can you paste an example log line?
lina: sure — from audit-bot: ```2026-03-18T22:04:12Z audit-bot KMS_ACCESS user=svc-data-ingest-12 action=Decrypt key=projects/prod/keys/customer-42 result=ALLOW via_role=legacy_default_role```
aj: so the migration left legacy_default_role bound somewhere and it still has secret read perms?
lina: right — the backfill created v3 roles but did not remove inherited bindings on the legacy role for service accounts that had been manually granted access. those manual bindings are the "shadow residuals".
devon: quick mitigation idea: revoke direct grants for legacy_default_role on KMS resources, then run a verification query. but need to ensure no legitimate use-cases.
samir: agree. propose migration: `perm_v3_cleanup_remove_legacy_bindings`. SQL to find candidates: ```sql
SELECT sa_id, resource_type, permission
FROM role_bindings
WHERE role_name = 'legacy_default_role'
  AND created_at < '2026-03-18T00:00:00Z'
  AND binding_source = 'manual';
```
maria: nice. and revoke script: ```sql
BEGIN;
UPDATE role_bindings SET role_name = NULL WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM candidates);
INSERT INTO audit_events (actor, action, detail) VALUES ('perm-cleanup', 'revoke_legacy_binding', '...');
COMMIT;
```
lina: runtime checklist before run: 1) snapshot role_bindings table (export), 2) run candidates query, 3) open a canary on shard9 with a dry-run mode (do not modify), 4) run verification against KMS audit logs to ensure no false positives.
aj: how long for step 3 canary? we should schedule during low traffic window.
devon: low traffic 01:00–04:00 UTC. canary window 30m, then 2h observation.
samir: also need a short rollback: reapply bindings from the snapshot if we see regressions. include a double-check to not reapplied ones that were intentionally manual. mark re-applies with a tag.
maria: can we auto-detect any dependent services by scanning last 7d for Decrypt usage from those SAs? quick query: ```sql
SELECT DISTINCT svc FROM kms_access_logs
WHERE key IN (select distinct key from candidates_keys)
  AND ts > now() - interval '7 days';
```
lina: yes will run that. I also want to add an alert dashboard tile: metric = count(kms_decrypt_allowed_by_legacy_role) over 5m. if >0 after canary, abort.
oncall-bot: @oncall-bot scheduled run window reserved for 2026-03-19T01:30:00Z - 2026-03-19T04:00:00Z for team eng-security.
aj: owners? lina leads the cleanup, samir handles queries + rollback plan, devon will run the DB job, maria will validate KMS logs + dashboard. I'll coordinate comms with support and CS for affected customers.
lina: assigning now. I'll post the dry-run results in this thread when done. expected dry-run at 2026-03-19T01:40Z UTC.
devon: ack — prepping migration script and perms to run on canary shard. keeping immutable snapshot in s3: s3://redwood-backups/rbac/perm_v3_cleanup/2026-03-19.tar.gz
samir: also flag for post-mortem: why manual bindings persisted — maybe binding_source drifted from 'manual' to 'migrated' incorrectly. want logs for backfill job.
maria: quick mitigation if we see high spike during canary: flip a feature flag to block KMS Decrypt for legacy role in auth proxy (fast rollback).
lina: good. last Q: any KMS key admin concerns? removing bindings doesn't change key policy object in KMS — we're only changing our internal role mapping. ensure we don't break provider-managed keys.
devon: noted. also run `kms:TestIamPermissions` after changes where possible.
lina: ok team — executing dry-run now, will paste output. :eyes:
audit-bot: DETECTED 3 MATCHES from dry-run candidates on shard9, listing svc ids: svc-data-ingest-12, svc-legacy-sync-3, svc-batch-export-7
lina: thanks. samir can you correlate those svc ids with 7d access patterns and mark any that are legitimate?
samir: on it, will have results in 20m.
maria: adding incident channel #inc-rbac-shadow for any escalations.
lina: wrapping up — cron of tasks posted in monday runbook. we won't remove bindings globally until canary + 2h observation is clean. will update thread with final status. :white_check_mark:
